title: Broncos DL Matt Henningsen tears Achilles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos DL Matt Henningsen tears Achilles
sources.description: Broncos defensive lineman Matt Henningsen, who was carted off at Friday's practice, was diagnosed with a torn Achilles, Mike Klis of 9News reports.
